meta.caveat: This is the SERVING six, not the six on court: a libero replaces a middle when that middle rotates to the back row, which is where the serve is, so middles often never appear.
meta.derivation: A team serves in rotation order by rule, so the order its players take the serve IS the rotation. Nothing is inferred and no threshold is chosen.
meta.source: NCAA play-by-play as published by the ncaavolleyballr package (MIT). stats.ncaa.org is never fetched.
